name: Oedipus Dating Sim
source:
"Thousands of years ago, lived a man named Oedipus, king of Thebes and slayer of The Sphinx.A man whose fate was to kill his father, Laius, and then marry his own mother, Jocasta.
But what if he could have gamed the system and cheated his own fate?"

With the generous help of three fates and Dionysus, the Olympian god with his own TV show, your task is to find a date for Oedipus. But it won't be as straightforward as it seems. At first, you won't know their true identities. Once you romance each character to a certain level, their true identity will be revealed to you. After that, you must avoid pairing Oedipus with Jocasta. A piece of cake, right? Well, other complications will certainly arise and maybe, with a little ingenuity, you can even end up with Jocasta and not be punished for it. But how?

This game was designed with replayability in mind. That means that there are many different choices to make, with lots of nooks and crannies to explore. While the overall structure of having 15 days with 4 time periods each remains the same every time you play, each character's American name, location in the Casino Hotel and alcoholic beverage of choice will change. If you have additional questions not answered by the dialog trees, you can also try typing the question directly to the character. Or you can use that feature while goofing off in a Let's Play. Who knows? The choice is yours!
translation:
“几千年前，住着一个名叫俄狄浦斯的人，底比斯国王，狮身人面像的杀手。这个人的命运是杀死他的父亲拉伊俄斯，然后娶了他自己的母亲伊俄卡斯塔。
但如果他可以玩弄系统并欺骗自己的命运呢？”

在三位命运女神和奥林匹亚神狄俄尼索斯（拥有自己的电视节目）的慷慨帮助下，你的任务是为俄狄浦斯找到一个约会对象。但事情不会像看起来那么简单。一开始，你不会知道他们的真实身份。一旦你与每个角色的浪漫达到一定程度，他们的真实身份就会向你揭露。此后，你必须避免将俄狄浦斯与伊俄卡斯塔配对。小菜一碟，对吧？好吧，肯定会出现其他并发症，也许，只要有一点聪明才智，你甚至可以最终得到伊俄卡斯塔，而不会因此受到惩罚。但如何呢？

这款游戏的设计考虑到了可重玩性。这意味着需要做出许多不同的选择，需要探索许多角落和缝隙。虽然每次玩游戏时15天、每个时间段的整体结构都保持不变，但每个角色的美国名字、赌场酒店的位置和选择的酒精饮料都会改变。如果对话树没有回答你的其他问题，你还可以尝试直接向角色输入问题。或者，你也可以在“Let's Play”中闲逛时使用该功能。谁知道？选择权在你！
